plugins.name: parquetry
plugins.description: Answer spatial questions with the Geomermaids parquetry reference datasets (GAUL, GMWID, FEMA NFHL, CORINE, Geoconnex US water features, Census, ACS, NRI, PAD-US, addresses, WorldPop, USA Structures, wildfire, NWI wetlands, NCES schools, OpenStreetMap North America) queried in place with DuckDB, and write optimized GeoParquet and PMTiles the way those datasets are written.
